|translation='''Title:''' Trample.

'''Card text:'''
At the same outdoor location as your piloted AT-AT, target one character, crashed vehicle, or unpiloted vehicle with maneuver. Draw destiny. A character target is lost if destiny exceeds ability. A vehicle target is lost if destiny is less than 7.

'''Lore:'''
The walker’s enormous feet are designed to step across a variety of terrain. Ruthless pilots use them to literally crush the Rebellion.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face names a piloted AT-AT.
